scope: Architecture Completion - Build Missing Bridges (8 gaps, MEDIUM complexity)

tasks.title: Implement Cross-service EventBus
tasks.description: Create IEventBus interface and TypedEventBus implementation. Support typed channels, wildcard subscriptions, synchronous in-process pub/sub. Register in DI container. Wire to IWebSocketRelayService for remote event mirroring.
tasks.convergence: IEventBus registered in DI; services can publish/subscribe typed events

tasks.title: Add LLM circuit breaker + cross-provider fallback
tasks.description: Implement CircuitBreaker class with closed→open→half-open state machine. Add per-provider circuit state tracking. Modify LLMServiceImpl.getProvider() to skip open-circuit providers and try fallback chain. Add CircuitOpenError. Configure failure threshold and cooldown period.
tasks.convergence: LLM calls skip open-circuit providers; automatic fallback to next available provider

tasks.title: Define ArtifactContract for workflow stage passing
tasks.description: Define IArtifactContract interface with inputSchema/outputSchema per stage. Create ArtifactResolver that validates and resolves references from state.json. Wrap existing handoff_package in typed contract. Backward compatible - existing Record<string,unknown> still works.
tasks.convergence: Workflow stages can declare typed artifact contracts; resolver validates references

tasks.title: Add SearchService hybrid strategy config
tasks.description: Define ISearchStrategyConfig interface with cascade order (local→semantic→external), fallback thresholds, and performance hints. Create SearchProfile presets. Extend HybridSearch to accept strategy config. Register in DI container.
tasks.convergence: SearchService has configurable strategy cascade with fallback thresholds

tasks.title: Implement Unified Search Pipeline
tasks.description: Create UnifiedSearchPipeline that coordinates KnowledgeService.search(), SmartSearch, HybridSearch, VectorSearch, and ObsidianService.search(). Normalize results, apply hybrid RRF scoring, deduplicate. Expose single search() method. Use strategy config from T04 for routing.
tasks.convergence: Single search endpoint merges all search backends with unified scoring

tasks.title: Add Delegate broker sub-plan dispatch
tasks.description: Add SubPlanSpec and SubPlanResult types to DelegateBroker. Implement submitSubPlan() that decomposes a task into parallel sub-tasks, tracks individual completion, and aggregates results. Publish sub-task events via IEventBus (T01).
tasks.convergence: DelegateBroker can decompose tasks into parallel sub-tasks with result aggregation

tasks.title: Add MCP Gateway request routing + provider fallback
tasks.description: Create MCPRequestRouter that maps tool calls to handlers with capability-based routing. Add ProviderFallbackChain that tries providers in order, checking circuit breaker state (T02). Integrate with existing gateway bootstrap.
tasks.convergence: MCP Gateway routes requests to capable providers with automatic fallback

tasks.title: Implement Nowledge Mem P1 bridge (Knowledge ↔ Graph bidirectional sync)
tasks.description: Extend NowledgeMemKnowledgeBridge with graph sync methods: syncEntityToGraph(), syncRelationToGraph(), syncGraphToKnowledge(). Add change detection and delta sync. Publish sync events via IEventBus (T01). Handle conflict detection via ConflictNowledgeBridge.
tasks.convergence: Knowledge entities/relations sync bidirectionally with Nowledge Mem graph
